# AyTool

> AyTool (aytool.com) is an independent Philippine payroll calculator site: free tools for SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG contributions, 13th month pay, take-home pay, holiday pay, night differential, overtime and final pay. Every rate is transcribed from the official government issuance (circular / advisory / regulation / proclamation), version-controlled, and shown with its effective date, last-verified date and source link. Not affiliated with any Philippine government agency. Calculations run client-side; no user data is collected.

Key facts currently in force (last verified 2026-08-19):
- SSS: 15% of Monthly Salary Credit (MSC ₱5,000–₱35,000); employee 5% / employer 10% + EC; OFW minimum MSC ₱8,000. Basis: SSS Circulars 2024-006/008/009/010 (effective Jan 2025, unchanged 2026).
- PhilHealth: 5% of monthly basic salary, floor ₱10,000 / ceiling ₱100,000; employed split 50/50. Basis: PhilHealth Circular 2020-0005 Rev. 1; Advisory 2026-0042.
- Pag-IBIG: employee 2% (1% if ≤₱1,500) + employer 2% on fund salary capped ₱10,000 (max ₱200+₱200). Basis: HDMF Circular 460.
- Withholding tax: BIR TRAIN monthly table effective 2023 onwards (Annex E, RR 11-2018).
- 2026 holidays: Proclamation No. 1006, s. 2025 (+1189/1264 for Eid); pay rules per DOLE Labor Advisory 12-25.
- 2027 holidays: Proclamation No. 1427, s. 2026 (signed 2026-09-08) — 10 regular holidays, 8 special non-working days, EDSA anniversary (Feb 25) a special working day; Eid'l Fitr and Eid'l Adha dates to follow by separate proclamation.

## Calculators

- [SSS Contribution Table 2026](https://aytool.com/sss-contribution-table/): full official schedule for Employee / Self-Employed / Voluntary / OFW with salary lookup. Source: sss.gov.ph.
- [SSS Contribution Calculator](https://aytool.com/sss-contribution-calculator/): monthly SSS contribution from salary + member type. Source: sss.gov.ph.
- [SSS Pension Calculator](https://aytool.com/sss-pension-calculator/): monthly retirement pension = highest of ₱300 + 20% AMSC + 2% AMSC per credited year over 10, 40% AMSC, or ₱1,000, with ₱1,200/₱2,400 minimums; AMSC counts MSC only up to ₱20,000 (Regular SS cap, Sec. 8(g)); ₱1,000 additional benefit allowance (Sec. 12(c)); 13th-month pension; dependents' pension (Sec. 12-A). Source: lawphil.net, sss.gov.ph/retirement-benefit/.
- [SSS Maternity Benefit Calculator](https://aytool.com/sss-maternity-benefit-calculator/): six highest MSCs (each capped at ₱20,000) ÷ 180 × 105 days (120 solo parent, 60 miscarriage); SSS example ₱16,000 MSC → ₱56,000; 3-contribution rule; employer salary differential and exemptions (RA 11210 Sec. 5; RA 11199 Sec. 8(n)). Source: lawphil.net, sss.gov.ph/maternity-benefit/.
- [SSS Salary Loan Calculator](https://aytool.com/sss-salary-loan-calculator/): one-month (36+ contributions) / two-month (72+) loan = average of 12 latest Regular SS MSCs rounded up (max ₱20,000 / ₱40,000), 1% service fee, 8% p.a. diminishing (10% for renewals with recent penalty condonation), pro-rated advance interest, 24 months from the 2nd month after approval, 1%/month penalty — SSS Circular 2025-004. Source: sss.gov.ph/salary-loan/.
- [SSS Sickness Benefit Calculator](https://aytool.com/sss-sickness-benefit-calculator/): 90% of ADSC (six highest MSCs ÷ 180, MSC capped ₱20,000) per compensable day beyond 3 days, max 120 days/year and 240 per confinement; 3-contribution rule; 5-day notice; employer advances, SSS reimburses (RA 11199 Sec. 14). Source: lawphil.net.
- [SSS Unemployment Benefit Calculator](https://aytool.com/sss-unemployment-benefit-calculator/): 50% of AMSC × 2 months (max ₱20,000), not over 60, 36 contributions with 12 in the last 18 months, involuntary separation, once every 3 years (RA 11199 Sec. 14-B). Source: lawphil.net.
- [Separation Pay Calculator](https://aytool.com/separation-pay-calculator/): one month per year (redundancy, labor-saving devices, impossible reinstatement) or half a month per year (retrenchment, closure, disease, lack of assignment), ≥6 months = 1 year, minimum one month, latest pay incl. regular allowances, tax-exempt (Labor Code Arts. 298–299; DOLE Handbook 2024 Ch. 14). Source: nwpc.dole.gov.ph handbook mirror.
- [Retirement Pay Calculator (RA 7641)](https://aytool.com/retirement-pay-calculator/): daily rate × 22.5 days (15 + 5 SIL + 2.5) × years, ages 60–65, ≥5 years' service, exempt retail/service/agri ≤10 employees, COLA excluded (Labor Code Art. 302; DOLE Handbook Ch. 15). Source: lawphil.net, nwpc.dole.gov.ph.
- [Daily Rate & Hourly Rate Calculator](https://aytool.com/daily-rate-calculator/): monthly ↔ daily ↔ hourly with DOLE factors 365 / 395 / 313 / 261 (305 / 253 if special days unpaid), hourly = daily ÷ 8, OT 125% and night-shift 110% hourly rates. Source: DOLE Handbook 2024.
- [PRC Board Exam Results 2026](https://aytool.com/board-exam-results-2026/): passers, examinees, pass rate and release date for every 2026 PRC exam released so far (21 exams incl. PNLE 28,652/37,359, LET 63,377/94,357, criminology, CPALE, CE, PLE, pharmacy, midwifery, MTLE, REE/RME, ME/CPM, architecture, ECE/ECT, dentistry, social work, psychologists) plus target dates still ahead; no lists of passers. Source: prc.gov.ph exam results releases.
- [13th Month Pay Calculator](https://aytool.com/13th-month-pay-calculator/): total basic salary earned ÷ 12 (PD 851 / DOLE), simple and month-by-month modes. Source: DOLE/BWC.
- [PhilHealth Contribution](https://aytool.com/philhealth-contribution/): 5% premium calculator + 2026 table with employee/employer split. Source: philhealth.gov.ph.
- [Pag-IBIG Contribution](https://aytool.com/pagibig-contribution/): HDMF savings calculator + table (2% + 2%, ₱10,000 MFS cap). Source: pagibigfund.gov.ph.
- [Minimum Wage Philippines 2026](https://aytool.com/minimum-wage-philippines/): daily minimum wage in every region from the latest wage orders, switched automatically on each effectivity date. NCR: ₱695/₱658 under NCR-26 through Sep 25, 2026; ₱755/₱718 under NCR-28 from Sep 26, 2026 (published Sep 11, 2026; effective 15 days after publication, date announced by DOLE); NCR-27 enjoined by the courts and never took effect. Range ₱401 (BARMM agri) to ₱695, ₱755 from Sep 26; on Dec 1, 2026 Bicol rises ₱455 → ₱480 and the BARMM second tranche lifts the floor to ₱426. Kasambahay monthly rates; DOLE factors 365/395/313/261 for monthly equivalents; BMBE and retail ≤10 exemption rules. Source: nwpc.dole.gov.ph.
- [Pag-IBIG MP2 Calculator](https://aytool.com/pagibig-mp2-calculator/): official MP2 dividend rates 2025 7.12%, 2024 7.10%, 2023 7.05%, 2022 7.03%, 2021 6.00% (2011–2020 from the earlier official page); ₱500 minimum per remittance, 5-year maturity, tax-free, ₱20M principal cap, compounded or annual payout, pre-termination grounds with 50% of dividends. Source: pagibigfund.gov.ph.
- [Pag-IBIG Housing Loan Calculator](https://aytool.com/pagibig-housing-loan-calculator/): rates until Dec 31, 2026 — 4.5% promo (≤₱4.9M) / 5.75% (₱4.9M–₱10M) for the first 3 years; regular 6.5% (5-yr) to 9.75% (30-yr fixing); Affordable Housing 3% for 5 years for socialized homes (₱950k house and lot / ₱1.8M condo; income < ₱47,855.82 NCR / ₱34,685.82 outside); max ₱10M (Circular 491, above ₱6M at 90% LTV), 30 years, age ≤65 at application / ≤70 at maturity, 24 monthly savings. Source: pagibigfund.gov.ph.
- [Pag-IBIG Salary Loan Calculator (MPL & Calamity Loan)](https://aytool.com/pagibig-salary-loan-calculator/): Multi-Purpose Loan up to 90% of Total Accumulated Value less outstanding MPL/Calamity/HELPs, 1.4583% a month diminishing balance incl. grace period, 12/24/36 months, 2-month grace (pay from the 3rd month), 12 monthly savings, renewal after 4 payments and the 6th month (Circular 469, 2025); Calamity Loan 5.95% a year, 3-month grace, apply within 90 days of the declaration (Circular 470); penalty 1/20 of 1% a day. Source: pagibigfund.gov.ph.
- [Salary Grade Table (Government, EO 64)](https://aytool.com/salary-grade-table/): civilian government salary grades 1–33, Steps 1–8 (SG 33: 2 steps) under EO No. 64 s. 2024 — 2026 tranche (DBM NBC 601): SG 1 ₱14,634, Teacher I SG 11 ₱31,705, Nurse I SG 15 ₱42,178, SG 33 ₱449,157–₱462,329; final tranche Jan 1, 2027: SG 1 ₱15,208, SG 11 ₱33,387 (page switches automatically); PERA ₱2,000/month, clothing up to ₱7,000, mid-year and year-end bonus one month each + ₱5,000 cash gift, medical allowance up to ₱7,000 (FY 2026 GAA); GSIS 9%/12% (RA 8291); LGU rates by income class; uniformed personnel excluded. Source: dbm.gov.ph.
- [Take-Home Pay Calculator](https://aytool.com/take-home-pay-calculator/): net monthly salary after SSS + PhilHealth + Pag-IBIG + BIR withholding tax, itemized. Sources: sss.gov.ph, philhealth.gov.ph, pagibigfund.gov.ph, bir.gov.ph.
- [Income Tax Calculator (BIR Tax Table 2026)](https://aytool.com/income-tax-calculator/): TRAIN graduated rates in force since Jan 1, 2023 (0% up to ₱250,000; 15% to 35%), BIR Annex E withholding tables (monthly: tax-free up to ₱20,833; semi-monthly ₱10,417; weekly ₱4,808; daily ₱685), contributions excluded (NIRC Sec. 32(B)(7)(f)), 13th month and other benefits exempt up to ₱90,000, minimum wage earners exempt, year-end annualization, substituted filing (Sec. 51-A). Source: bir.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [Freelancer Tax Calculator (8% vs Graduated)](https://aytool.com/freelancer-tax-calculator/): 8% of gross sales/receipts above ₱250,000 (no ₱250,000 deduction for mixed income earners) in lieu of graduated rates and the 3% percentage tax, for gross up to the ₱3M VAT threshold; vs graduated rates with 40% OSD or itemized deductions plus 3% percentage tax; election in the 1st-quarter return (1701Q/2551Q) or BIR Form 1905/1901, irrevocable, every year (RR 8-2018, RMO 23-2018); residents taxed on worldwide income. Source: bir.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [Holiday Pay Calculator](https://aytool.com/holiday-pay-calculator/): 200%/130% holiday multipliers + official 2026 Philippine holiday calendar. Sources: pco.gov.ph, dole.gov.ph.
- [Philippine Holidays 2027](https://aytool.com/philippine-holidays/): official 2027 list under Proclamation No. 1427 — regular holidays, special non-working days, long weekends, holidays falling on weekends, and what changed from 2026. Source: pco.gov.ph.
- [Night Differential Calculator](https://aytool.com/night-differential-calculator/): 10% night shift differential (10 PM–6 AM) with holiday/OT stacking. Source: DOLE handbook.
- [Service Incentive Leave (SIL) Calculator](https://aytool.com/service-incentive-leave-calculator/): 5 days with pay a year after one year of service (Labor Code Art. 95), unused SIL converted to cash at the daily rate on conversion, pro rata (DOLE example: hired Jan 1, 2023, resigned Mar 1, 2024, ₱610/day → 5.833 days = ₱3,558.13); 8 exclusions (government, managerial, field personnel, <10 employees…); statutory leaves: maternity 105/120/60 days (RA 11210), paternity 7 days (RA 8187), solo parent 7 working days (RA 11861), VAWC 10 days (RA 9262), special leave for women up to 2 months (RA 9710). Source: DOLE Handbook 2024.
- [Final Pay Calculator](https://aytool.com/final-pay-calculator/): back pay estimate (unpaid salary, leave conversion, pro-rated 13th month, separation pay), DOLE 30-day release rule. Source: DOLE Labor Advisory 06-20.
- [Overtime Pay Calculator](https://aytool.com/overtime-pay-calculator/): OT rates 125%–338% by day type with night-hour handling. Source: DOLE handbook.
- [Senior Citizen & PWD Discount Calculator](https://aytool.com/senior-citizen-discount-calculator/): 20% discount + VAT exemption (RA 9994 Sec. 4; RA 10754) computed on the VAT-exempt price per BIR RR 7-2010 (₱1,120 ÷ 1.12 = ₱1,000, less 20% = ₱800; about 28.57% off, not 32%); promo or 20% whichever is higher; only the holder's own orders, all-senior groups each qualify; no discount on children's meals, party packages, bulk orders; at least 5% on electricity/water if meter in the senior's name and ≤100 kWh / ≤30 m³. Source: lawphil.net, BIR.
- [OEC Exemption Guide](https://aytool.com/oec-exemption/): Balik-Manggagawa exemption criteria, a 5-question eligibility checker, and the eGovPH OFW Travel Pass process. Source: dmw.gov.ph (Advisory 38-2025).
- [First Time Jobseeker Certificate (RA 11261)](https://aytool.com/first-time-jobseeker/): Filipino first-time jobseekers (resident of the barangay ≥6 months per IRR; no age limit, 15–17 need parental consent; JobStart beneficiaries excluded) get one free copy each, once, within 1 year of the free Barangay Certification (Oath of Undertaking, no notarization): barangay clearance, NBI clearance (normally ₱130 + ₱30), police clearance (₱150 + fee), PSA birth/marriage certificate (₱155 outlet), public-hospital medical certificate (not lab tests), public-school records, TIN, UMID, CSC eligibility, PhilHealth ID, Mayor's Clearance, MARINA/TESDA certificates, OEC; not free: passport, apostille, PRC and CSC exams, LTO license. Sources: RA 11261, IRR (JMC 001-2019), Joint Operational Guidelines (May 12, 2023), NBI/PNP/PSA sites.
- [How to Get an SSS Number Online](https://aytool.com/how-to-get-sss-number/): sss.gov.ph online application (email link valid 5 days, My.SSS activation link 30 days), no fee, ~20 minutes; number is Temporary (contributions only) until a birth certificate or government ID is approved (2 working days) → Permanent; employer files R1A; forgotten numbers verified only at a branch. Source: sss.gov.ph, SSS Citizen's Charter 2026.
- [How to Get a TIN Number (BIR)](https://aytool.com/how-to-get-tin-number/): employees registered by the employer in ORUS Employer Service Link (Form 1902, 3 days, free); self-employed register in ORUS (Form 1901, ₱30 loose DST for e-COR); one-time taxpayers Form 1904; first TIN card free (₱100 replacement); Digital TIN ID free in ORUS and eGovPH (RMC 120-2023, 34-2026); one TIN only — NIRC Sec. 236(J)/275 fine ≤₱1,000 and/or ≤6 months; verify via BIR Mobile TIN Verifier App. Source: bir.gov.ph, orus.bir.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [How to Get a Pag-IBIG MID Number](https://aytool.com/how-to-get-pagibig-mid-number/): Virtual Pag-IBIG → Be a Member → Register (National ID liveness/QR or valid ID + proof of income + selfie) → Registration Tracking Number → Verify MID Number after 2–3 working days; no registration fee; Loyalty Card Plus ₱125; recover MID via official Facebook page, contactus@pagibigfund.gov.ph or any branch. Source: pagibigfund.gov.ph, pagibigfundservices.com.
- [How to Get a PhilHealth Number (PIN)](https://aytool.com/how-to-get-philhealth-number/): Member Portal → PhilHealth Member Registration (one application per email, PMRF + birth certificate/ID upload, PIN emailed in 3–5 working days); employer route (2 PMRF copies to HR, ER1/ER2); LHIO walk-in; no fee; no online PIN recovery — check MDR/HR or visit an LHIO. Source: philhealth.gov.ph, memberinquiry.philhealth.gov.ph.
- [PRC Board Exam Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/prc-board-exam-schedule/): all 88 scheduled licensure exams with application windows (PRC Resolution 2113, s. 2025). Source: prc.gov.ph.
- [Nursing Board Exam Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/nursing-board-exam-schedule/): PNLE Feb 26–27 & Aug 29–30, 2026 (both held; Aug–Sep results released Sep 18, 2026, 28,652 of 37,359 passed), filing windows, PNLE pass-rate history 2019–2026 from PRC press releases, and what is known about the 2027 schedule (not yet released by PRC, expected Nov 2026). Source: prc.gov.ph.
- [LET / BLEPT Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/let-board-exam-schedule/): teachers board exam Mar 15 & Sep 20, 2026, filing windows, passing rule (75%, no subject below 50%, BPT Res. 228 s. 1996), requirements under RA 7836/RA 9293, March 2026 pass rates. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [Criminology Board Exam Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/criminology-board-exam-schedule/): CLE Feb 4–6 & Aug 1–3, 2026 (both held), passing rule 75%/60% with deferred-subject retake (RA 11131 Sec. 17), six subjects and weights, five-failure refresher rule. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [CPA Board Exam (CPALE) Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/cpa-board-exam-schedule/): May 24–26 & Oct 24–26, 2026, passing rule 75%/65% with conditional credit (RA 9298 Sec. 16), six subjects, two-failure refresher rule (Sec. 18), May 2026 pass rate. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [Civil Engineering Board Exam Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/civil-engineering-board-exam-schedule/): CELE Mar 26–27 & Sep 26–27, 2026, requirements under RA 544, exam parts and weights; passing average is set by the Board under RA 8981 (the widely quoted 70%/50% is not in any published resolution). Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [Physician Licensure Exam (PLE) Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/physician-board-exam-schedule/): Mar 23–24 & 30–31 and Oct 3–4 & 10–11, 2026, passing rule 75%/50% (RA 2382 Sec. 21 as amended by RA 4224), twelve subjects, third-failure refresher rule, March 2026 pass rate. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [Pharmacy Board Exam Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/pharmacy-board-exam-schedule/): Apr 18–19 (held, 1,085 of 1,895 passed) & Oct 15–16, 2026, passing rule 75%/50% (RA 10918 Sec. 17), six weighted subjects, third-failure refresher rule. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [Midwifery Board Exam Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/midwifery-board-exam-schedule/): Apr 14–15 (held, 901 of 2,124 passed) & Nov 7–8, 2026, passing rule 75%/50% (RA 7392 Sec. 16), five subjects, requirements incl. RN route with 20 deliveries. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [Psychometrician Board Exam Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/psychometrician-board-exam-schedule/): rescheduled from Aug 19–20 to Sep 1–2, 2026 (Pampanga Sep 17–18), passing rule 75%/60% with two-year subject retake (RA 10029 Sec. 18), four subjects 20/20/20/40, September 2025 pass rate. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [RadTech Board Exam Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/radtech-board-exam-schedule/): once a year, Dec 10–11, 2026 (filing Sep 11–Nov 10), passing rule 75%/60% with subject re-examination (RA 7431 Sec. 22), five subjects at 20%, December 2025 pass rate. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [Electrical Engineering Board Exam (REE) Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/electrical-engineering-board-exam-schedule/): Apr 21–22 & Sep 5–6, 2026 (Sep results: REE 1,676 of 3,399; RME 715 of 961), passing rule 70%/50% with unlimited subject retakes (RA 7920 Sec. 19(b), 21), subjects 25/30/45, RME 50/50. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [Mechanical Engineering Board Exam Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/mechanical-engineering-board-exam-schedule/): Feb 11–13 & Aug 7–9, 2026 (Aug: ME 1,362 of 3,686), passing rule 70%/50% (RA 8495 Sec. 18), subjects 35/35/30, one-year wait after a third failure (Sec. 20). Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [Architecture Board Exam Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/architecture-board-exam-schedule/): Jan 20 & 22 and Jun 8 & 10, 2026 (Jun: 2,799 of 3,290), passing rule 70%/50% (RA 9266 Sec. 15), two-year diversified experience requirement (Sec. 13), subjects 30/30/40. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [ECE Board Exam Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/electronics-engineering-board-exam-schedule/): Mar 17–18 & Oct 17–18, 2026 (Mar: ECE 1,692 of 2,746; ECT 1,907 of 2,440), passing rule 70% in each subject with one removal exam for 60–69% (RA 9292 Sec. 16), subjects 20/20/30/30. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [Dentistry Board Exam Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/dentistry-board-exam-schedule/): written May 4–6 & Nov 22–24, practical May 11–14 & Nov 28–Dec 5, 2026 (May: 796 of 896), passing rule 75% GWA on written 60% / practical 40%, no rating below 50% (RA 9484 Sec. 16; Board Res. 02 s. 2021), refresher after three consecutive failures. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [Social Work Board Exam Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/social-work-board-exam-schedule/): Sep 9–11, 2026 (8,383 of 10,991 passed), once a year, passing rule 70%/50% (RA 4373 Sec. 14), requirements incl. age 18 (RA 10847) and 1,000 case hours, five subjects at 20%. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.
- [MedTech Board Exam (MTLE) Schedule 2026](https://aytool.com/medtech-board-exam-schedule/): Mar 5–6 & Aug 15–16, 2026 (both held; Aug results 4,204 of 5,634), passing rule 75%/50% plus the 60%-of-weights proviso (RA 5527 Sec. 19), six weighted subjects, three-failure refresher rule, 70% MLT registration rule. Source: prc.gov.ph, lawphil.net.

## Data

- [PRC Board Exam Schedule 2026 (JSON)](https://aytool.com/data/prc-board-exam-schedule-2026.json): all 88 exams with dates, application windows, target result dates and actual release dates once PRC publishes results, as rendered on the page. Source: prc.gov.ph.
- [Minimum Wage Philippines 2026 (JSON)](https://aytool.com/data/minimum-wage-philippines-2026.json): rebuilt daily — every region's wage order in force, effectivity, sector tiers and daily rates, plus any scheduled order or tranche (upcoming), the NCR-26/27/28 record, kasambahay monthly rates and the DOLE conversion factors. Source: nwpc.dole.gov.ph.
- PRC exam calendar files: one .ics per exam at https://aytool.com/data/prc/2026/<exam-slug>.ics (filing deadline + exam day), linked from every row of the schedule table.
- [Philippine Holidays 2027 (JSON)](https://aytool.com/data/philippine-holidays-2027.json): every 2027 holiday with date and type (regular / special non-working / special working), plus the Eid holidays still awaiting a date. Source: pco.gov.ph.
- [Philippine Holidays 2026 (JSON)](https://aytool.com/data/philippine-holidays-2026.json): the 2026 list in the same format, Eid dates included. Source: pco.gov.ph.
